<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Implements a pulse detector for detecting transitions from 0 to 1 to 0.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="S0">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">First state after detecting '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">Second state after detecting '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">Final state after detecting '0'.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" width_description="[2:0]">Register to hold the current state.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[2:0]">Next state based on current state and inputs.</reg>
        
        <always_comb>
            case(state)
                S0: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                    end
                end
                
                S1: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S2;
                    end
                end
                
                S2: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S3;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                
                S3: begin
                    if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S0;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                
                default: next_state = S0;
            endcase
        </always_comb>
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(~rst_n) begin
                state <= S0;
                data_out <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
                
                if(next_state == S3 && ~data_in) begin
                    data_out <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    data_out <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Sequential logic for pulse detection.</implementation>
</module>
